hero.headline: Come build
hero.body: We are a small remote team building and growing websites for B2B SaaS companies, and for brands like Montblanc and Radisson. We care about what you have shipped.

roles.title: Open
roles.unavailable: We could not load our current openings just now. Please try again shortly — or send an application anyway, which reaches us either way.
roles.empty: We hire in bursts, and we read what comes in between them. Send us your work anyway — a real person reads it, and we keep the ones we like on file for when a role does open.

how.title: How this
how.lede: We are a small remote team. There is no applicant-tracking maze here, and no take-home project before anyone has spoken to you.

steps.title: You fill in one form
steps.body: A few minutes. The questions change with the role, and most ask for a short intro video, because we would rather meet you than read about you.

steps.title: A person reads it
steps.body: Not a keyword filter. We look at what you have actually shipped — not where you studied, and not how long your CV is.

steps.title: If it is a fit, we talk
steps.body: A call with the team first. Arnel, who founded LoudFace, takes the final conversation and the final decision himself.

closing.title: Not sure which role you fit?
closing.body: Pick the closest one and tell us what you have built. We would rather see the work and sort out the title afterwards.

apply.title: Come build
apply.intro: We're a small remote team headquartered in Dubai, with an office in the United States. We work with leading companies such as Toku, Eraser, Montblanc, and Radisson Hotels.
apply.basisLead: We do not hire based on your CV or the number of courses you have taken. We hire based on:
basis: how well you fit our culture
the results you achieved in previous roles
apply.note: One form, a few minutes. A person reads every one.
